text: Independent conformance complete using raw byte-authored fixtures rather than Nifti.writeVec. Focused audit 10/10 covers uint8/int16/int32/float32/float64, big-endian header+payload, slope/intercept, slope=0, truncation, unsupported datatype, mismatched bitpix, arbitrary time/voxel order, finite outputs, and explicit tolerances. Structural 200 x 50k guard remains 1 window/TR, 200 planned reads, 403,992-byte max buffer. Independent benchmark rerun: 0.177 s and 434.9 MiB/s; wall-clock remains informational.
